native_hardware_sequence.note: 35 native hardware tests ran before test-only lint/constant-source fixture cleanup and final runtime-profile selection. Production shader/renderer code is unchanged by those steps; workspace and affected renderer suites were repeated, native normal tests/lints were repeated after style edits, and native unit tests were repeated after selecting High density. Full captures exercise the chosen High profile.

profile_selection.reason: High restores near trees and uses the existing whole-partition raster fallback at the RT instance limit. Different population/admission paths make this a quality-mode comparison, not an isolated speedup.

isolated_discard_specialization.note: Preceding isolated diagnostic, not pixel-exact and not an end-to-end gain for the changed final scene; one run per variant.

limitations: Reference parity not achieved; unmatched concept L1 is not acceptance.
Sparse far understory and repeated archetypes; no bounded planet-wide vegetation streamer.
Floor mixtures are authored optical priors, not resolved debris or measured peat.
Cloud single scattering with isotropic diffuse boundary; no complete aerial/multiple transport.
Thin geometry aliases; TAA off. A sweep records a final still/counters, not a video or temporal-stability envelope.
Production GPU performance and cross-platform visual acceptance not achieved.
